title: Quantitative simplex and dimension bounds for minimum-potential equal-mass configurations
exact_target: Determine whether equal-mass minimum-potential central configurations must have nontrivial symmetry.

status_qualification: The source remarks that the symmetry expectation appears false for n=47 and discusses normalization. This historical indication is disclosed; no current universal symmetry theorem or reviewed counterexample is claimed. The dimension and meaning of symmetric must be stated in a proposed theorem.
